title: publish-guard config.json
description: Auto-deploy repositories, principal naming, and per-site descriptors for the publish guard.

auto_deploy_repos.description: Absolute repository paths a git push publishes. Bare strings use the default site descriptor.

principal_name.description: Name interpolated into block messages. Empty or absent: messages say 'the principal'.

sites.description: Per-site descriptors keyed by absolute repository path. Repos without an entry use the default descriptor.

label.description: Short site name for messages and records.

principal_name.description: Per-site override for the top-level principal_name.

content_layout.description: nested-date scans each content root for index.md; flat scans for *.md.

content_roots.description: Repo-relative directories the timeline invariants scan. Absent: the default pair (content/posts as nested-date, astro-site/src/content/articles as flat).
